name: Cusco
tagline: Air thinner than expected, kindness thicker.
journal:
Cusco at 11,000 feet — the first morning I climbed three flights of stairs and had to sit down. The locals smiled and handed me coca tea like this happens twice a day to them, because it does.

The stones in the city walls fit together so well you couldn't slide a knife between them. Inca masonry. Six hundred years and still no gaps.

Machu Picchu the next week, in the kind of cloud cover that makes a place feel like it's choosing whether to show itself.
